services.title: What we do
services.lead: Prices are starting points for a typical job. Your quote is fixed once we have seen the space.
services.pageLead: Five things we do every week, and do well. Every job starts with a visit and a fixed quote.

steps.title: You send a request
steps.text: By form, phone or email. We reply within one working day to arrange a visit.

steps.title: We visit and measure
steps.text: We look at the space, check the surfaces and talk through colours and dates. The visit is free.

steps.title: You get a fixed quote
steps.text: Within {days} working days, with everything included. The price does not change.

steps.title: We do the work and hand over
steps.text: On the agreed dates, cleaned up at the end of each day. We walk through the result with you.

about.title: About us
about.lead: A family business with eight painters, two apprentices and one simple rule: leave every home cleaner than we found it.
story: Lindenhof started as a one-man workshop in Ostermundigen. Today the second generation runs the business, still from the same yard.
We train apprentices every year, work with Swiss paint manufacturers and keep our teams small, so you always know who is in your home.

values.title: A fixed price
values.text: The quote is the price. Extra work is quoted before we do it.

values.title: A clean site
values.text: We cover, tidy up every evening and clean at the end.

values.title: One contact person
values.text: From the first visit to the handover, you deal with the same person.
